page.overview:
What is Deep Sea Tooth?

Deep Sea Tooth, spelled DeepSeaTooth prior to , is an item introduced in Generation III.

The Deep Sea Tooth raises Clamperl's Special Attack if held by it. The Deep Sea Tooth is also an evolution item, evolving Clamperl into Huntail if it is traded while holding the item. The Deep Sea Tooth has a counterpart named Deep Sea Scale, which evolves Clamperl into Gorebyss instead.

Although the Deep Sea Tooth does not appear in , both games still have unique flavor text of it.
